title.zh: 修订马尼拉市宪章并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act to Revise the Charter of the City of Manila, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Amending Section Eighteen (Cc) of Republic Act Numbered Four Hundred Nine, as Amended, Entitled, "An Act to Revise the Charter of the City of Manila, and for Other Purposes."

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6039_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: If any provision of this Act is declared invalid, the provisions thereof not affected by such declaration shall remain in force and effect.

Violation of this Act shall be punishable by a fine of not less than two hundred pesos but not more than two thousand pesos and by imprisonment for a period of not less than six months but not exceeding one year, at the discretion of the Court, plus disqualification to hold public office if committed by a public official or employee.
All laws, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: August 4, 1969
